pins.head: BINS GO UNDER THE FRAME
pins.sub: The Space You Already Pay For
pins.title: Small Bedroom Organization: Use the Space Under the Bed Frame
pins.desc: Small bedroom organization gets easier once the floor under the bed counts as storage. Soft bins on the frame rails take off-season clothes and spare bedding without adding a dresser, and a slim nightstand keeps the walking space clear so the room still reads as a bedroom rather than a storage unit. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #UnderBedStorage #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A small bedroom corner in morning light: a slim light wood nightstand with a lamp, a wooden tray and a mug beside the bed, two grey fabric bins tucked under the wooden bed frame and a linen curtain at the window.

pins.head: A ROD WEDGED WALL TO WALL
pins.title: Renter Friendly Storage: A Laundry Nook With Nothing Drilled
pins.desc: Renter friendly storage works best where the walls already give you something to push against. A tension rod wedged across a narrow alcove holds hangers for anything that has to drip dry, an over-the-door rack takes the towels, and a rolling cart carries the rest out of the way. Everything comes down on moving day without a patch kit. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #NoDrillStorage #LaundryRoom
pins.alt: A narrow laundry alcove with a white tension rod wedged wall to wall holding four wooden hangers, a white over-the-door wire rack of rolled towels on the right and a white three-tier rolling cart stacked with folded linens.

pins.head: BUY FOR THE MOLD YOU HAVE
pins.title: How Much Resin Do I Need? Size the Kit to the Mold You Own
pins.desc: How much resin do I need is really a question about the molds on your bench, not the best price per ounce. Work out the volume your molds actually hold, add a little for the cup and the stir stick, and buy the kit that covers it. A big kit you open once sits half cured on the shelf by the next project. Contains affiliate links. #EpoxyResin #ResinCrafts #CraftSupplies
pins.alt: Two plain amber glass bottles standing on a pale concrete counter beside a tall clear mixing cup half filled with clear liquid, with an empty shallow rectangular silicone tray mold in front of them.

pins.head: LITTLE MOLDS WASTE LESS
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: Start With Small Jewelry Molds
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners is cheapest to learn on jewelry molds. A bar or pendant takes a thimble of resin, so a batch that goes cloudy or sets with a bubble costs almost nothing, and you get three or four tries out of the mixing cup you would have spent on one tray. Scale up once the mix behaves. Contains affiliate links. #ResinJewelry #ResinArt #BeginnerCrafts
pins.alt: Two slim clear resin bar pendants with gold flakes suspended inside lying on a dark charcoal slate tile, with a white silicone bar mold behind them, a coil of fine gold chain and a pair of flat-nose pliers.

pins.head: WASH THEM BEFORE THEY DRY
pins.title: Miniature Painting Tips: Reset the Brushes Before You Stop
pins.desc: Most miniature painting tips about brushes are really about the five minutes at the end. Acrylic that dries in the ferrule splays the tip for good, so rinse while the paint is still wet, work a little brush soap through the bristles, reshape the point and stand them upright to dry. A clean point is cheaper than a new brush. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #BrushCare #AcrylicPainting
pins.alt: Clean round brushes with plain wooden handles standing bristles-up in a speckled stoneware jar on a pale oak desk, with a shallow glass dish of clean water in front, a folded grey cloth and a round cake of brush soap in an open tin.

pins.head: DROPPERS BEAT TUBES
pins.title: Acrylic Painting for Beginners: A Dropper Set for Miniatures
pins.desc: Acrylic painting for beginners on small figures is easier out of dropper bottles than tubes. One squeeze puts a measured drop on the palette, the bottle seals between colors so nothing skins over, and a starter range of basic shades covers most of a figure before you buy anything specific. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #AcrylicPaint #CraftSupplies
pins.alt: A row of small plain dropper bottles of acrylic paint in teal, ochre, red, bone, olive and slate standing on a pale oak desk, with a wooden-handled round brush lying in front and a grey primed knight miniature on a cork base at the right.
